change_summary: tools/run-preview.ps1 accepts -Ui FormalWinUI: selects .local/preview/WinUI/Hibiki.WinUI.exe (the formal MSBuild/XAML shell from build-preview.ps1 -Target WinUI), requires Windows App Runtime 1.7 x64 exactly like WinUICompat (fail-closed with an actionable message otherwise), builds via -Target WinUI when missing or with -Build, and flows through the existing -SmokeTest and engine-flag paths.
-Ui Auto behavior is intentionally unchanged (WinUICompat when the runtime is present, else DesktopCompat); the formal shell remains explicit opt-in.
Launcher self-test extended to 22 cases covering FormalWinUI resolution with and without the runtime.

coverage: engine preview built and started hidden
formal XAML shell built via visual-studio-msbuild and launched
launch smoke kept the UI alive for the bounded window and closed it safely

limitations: User-space launcher tooling only; no driver, WaveRT, HLK or Microsoft signing evidence.
FormalWinUI remains framework-dependent on Windows App Runtime 1.7 x64 by design.
Auto selection is unchanged; no behavior change for existing DesktopCompat/WinUICompat users beyond the shared runtime-requirement message wording.
